title: Failed to populate field in ros2 topic pub and service call: YAML forms that work, measured
excerpt: Exact ros2 topic pub and ros2 service call YAML errors on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: missing space after colon, wrong or flat fields, arrays, byte[] vs uint8[], header stamp now/auto, shell quoting, interface proto --no-quotes, and how many -1, -w 0 and -r messages arrived.
